校巴服務最新安排（2026年9月1日起生效）：1A線改為1線；1B線取消；新增2S線；2線取消每小時00及30分班次，15及45分班次維持不變；7線班次及服務時間調整；8線改由康本園開出；H線取消停靠十苑站。

Campus bus service updates (effective 1 September 2026): Route 1A is renamed Route 1; Route 1B is cancelled; Route 2S is added; Route 2 cancels the :00 and :30 departures while :15 and :45 remain; Route 7 schedule and service hours are adjusted; Route 8 starts from Yasumoto International Academic Park; Route H no longer stops at Residence No. 10.
